name: Geo Heatmap
summary: Kernel density surface of point locations, optionally weighted by a value, in the theme's sequential colours; toggle to reveal the underlying points.
summary_zh: 点位的核密度热力面（可按数值加权），使用主题顺序色阶；可一键叠加显示原始点位。
description_zh: 用连续的热力面展示点位在空间上的集中程度，适合看“哪里最密集 / 规模最集中”，例如产能、门店、客户或交易的地理集中度。每行一个点（lat / lon），可指定 weight 字段（如产能、收入）加权，权重按全量数据归一化，邻近点叠加。颜色来自主题顺序色阶，图例为相对密度（低 → 高）并注明点数与合计；radius / blur 控制平滑程度。右上角按钮可叠加原始点位，悬停查看详情、点击交叉筛选。
best_for: Hundreds+ of points where individual markers are noise
Quick 'where is the weight' overview next to a table
avoid_when: Few points (use bubble-map — a heat surface over 10 points misleads)
Exact values must be read (density is relative)
Values attached to countries rather than points (use choropleth)

weight.desc: Optional weight per point (normalised to the largest point)

label.desc: Point name for the points overlay tooltip / click-to-filter

intensity.desc: Weight of the heaviest single point (0-1); overlapping points add up and saturate at 1

minOpacity.desc: Floor opacity of the faintest density

gradient.desc: Custom {stop: colour} map (stops 0-1); defaults to the theme sequential ramp

pointsToggle.desc: On-map button to show / hide the points (hidden in print)

fit.desc: Initial view: 'data' | 'world' | [[south, west], [north, east]] | {center: [lat, lon], zoom}

legend.desc: Show the density legend with point count / total

filterField.desc: Field used when clicking a point; defaults to encode.label. Shared business dimensions (country, company, sector, region, segment, year…) filter the whole report; other fields (site name, type, from / to…) only this block's dataset — set crossFilterScope to override

scrollZoom.desc: Plain mouse-wheel zoom: 'click' (armed after clicking the map, so page scrolling is never hijacked) | true | false. Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or a trackpad pinch always zooms; +/- buttons and drag too

interactions: Hover a point for its fields; click to cross-filter
